name: Murder Your Friends [NEW]
desc:
Murder Your Friends is a single player murder game where you murder NPC versions of your friends!

Training Mode: Practice your aim and try out different settings
Classic Mode: Eliminate all the NPCs
Timed Mode: Eliminate the NPCs before the timer runs out
VS Mode: 1v1 duel against NPC
Multiplayer: Murder NPCs with up to 8 players
